fact: The interior and foreign ministries announced in a joint statement on a Thursday evening in January 2026 a new digital service letting Algerians born abroad file requests to register or correct their civil-status documents at the communes instead of the foreign ministry's central service, through data exchange between the two sectors, first in the communes of Algiers wilaya and the seat communes of the other wilayas, with all communes to follow.
title: الجزائر تطلق خدمة تصحيح وثائق المولودين بالخارج عبر البلديات
